title: LoveBud Node runtime policy
decision_note: LoveBud supports exactly two Node runtimes with scoped reasons. Node 20 is the default repository-side GitHub Actions / Product CI / tooling runtime and the merge gate. Node 22.13.0 is scoped to the Reliability Preview rehearsal only.
runtime_boundary_note: This policy pins repository-side GitHub Actions / CI / tooling runtimes and the local rehearsal runtime it declares. It does not pin the Cloudflare deployed or build runtime: that runtime is selected by Cloudflare, and wrangler.toml nodejs_compat is a Cloudflare compatibility behavior, not a Node process-version pin.

scopes.surface: Repository-side GitHub Actions runners building and testing Product source and tooling, ordinary contract/unit/smoke/route tests, DB-engine PostgreSQL jobs, and branch authority governance contracts. This pins the repository-side CI/tooling runtime only; it does not pin the Cloudflare deployed/build runtime.
scopes.reason: Node 20 is the current GitHub Actions Product runtime and the merge gate. Existing CI evidence is generated on Node 20 and local Node 22 evidence cannot replace it.

reason_sources.required_token: Node 20 GitHub Actions CI remains the merge gate.

scopes.surface: Hermetic Reliability Preview rehearsal suite in tests/reliability-preview and the workers/reliability-preview local runtime adapter.
scopes.reason: The rehearsal suite requires the node:sqlite DatabaseSync API for its in-memory store; that API is not available on the Node 20 runtime.

undeclared_version_sources.note: A version file would create a second, silent runtime authority. Add it only with an explicit policy update and guard change in the same PR.
Same as .nvmrc: absent by decision, not by accident.
package.json engines is deliberately not a runtime authority for this repository.

drift_rules: Every active actions/setup-node occurrence in .github/workflows/*.yml must be registered in workflow_occurrences with the same workflow, node_version, and count.
An unregistered occurrence, a removed registration, a changed node_version, or a changed count fails closed.
An actions/setup-node step without a literal node-version, or with node-version-file or a ${{ }} expression, fails closed.

Supported uses forms are a plain, single-quoted, or double-quoted actions/setup-node value with an optional trailing comment. A uses line that still names actions/setup-node outside that grammar (unterminated quote, extra tokens) fails closed as UNPARSED_SETUP_NODE_USE instead of being skipped.

A uses line may define an anchor for a supported action value (&name actions/setup-node@vN) and other uses lines may alias it (*name); the alias is counted as an occurrence with its own node-version. Any other anchor/alias shape on a uses line - an anchor with no readable action value, a nested anchor/alias, or an alias whose anchor is not a readable setup-node definition in the same file - fails closed as INDIRECT_USES_UNRESOLVED, because an unresolved alias could point at actions/setup-node. Anchors on whole step mappings are scanned at their definition site.
A node_version that is not declared by a scope fails closed.
A scope that no workflow occurrence references, or a registration that references an unknown scope or a mismatched version, fails closed.
Every scope reason_sources entry must exist and contain its required_token.
The human document must exist and name every scope id and node_version.
change_procedure: Update config/node-runtime-policy.json, docs/engineering/NODE_RUNTIME_POLICY.md, and the affected workflow node-version lines in one reviewable PR.
Run npm run check:node-runtime and node --test tests/contracts/node-runtime-policy-4534.test.cjs.
Run npm run verify (the guard is enforced there for CI).
